candidates.title: zip2zip: Inference-Time Adaptive Tokenization via Online Compression
candidates.abstract: Tokenization efficiency plays a critical role in the performance and cost of large language models (LLMs), yet most models rely on static tokenizers optimized on general-purpose corpora. These tokenizers'fixed vocabularies often fail to adapt to domain- or language-specific inputs, leading to longer token sequences and higher computational costs. We introduce zip2zip, a novel method for achieving context-adaptive tokenization in LLMs at inference time. Leveraging an online data compression algorithm (Lempel-Ziv-Welch), zip2zip dynamically expands its active vocabulary at inference time by continuously replacing fragmented token sequences with more compact hypertokens, which it can immediately output during generation. In doing so, the model refines its internal tokenization scheme to match the token distribution of the current context, reducing redundancy and improving representational efficiency. zip2zip consists of three key components: (1) a tokenizer based on Lempel-Ziv-Welch compression that incrementally merges co-occurring tokens into reusable hypertokens on the fly; (2) a dynamic embedding (and unembedding) layer that computes embeddings for newly formed hypertokens at runtime; and (3) a variant of autoregressive language modeling that pretrains the model to handle hypertokenized, compressed text sequences as inputs and outputs. We show that an existing LLM can be uptrained for zip2zip in 10 GPU-hours via parameter-efficient finetuning. The resulting LLM performs test-time adaptation, learning to use hypertokens in unseen contexts and reducing input and output tokens by 15-40%.
candidates.reason: zip2zipはLZW式のオンライン圧縮で推論時に語彙を適応的に拡張し、断片化したトークン列を hypertoken へ置換して生成時のトークン数と計算コストを削減する推論時トークン圧縮であり、LLM推論の効率化に直接貢献する。

candidates.title: SpecInfer: Accelerating Generative Large Language Model Serving with Speculative Inference and Token Tree Verification
candidates.reason: SpecInferは小規模投機モデルの予測をトークンツリーとして構成し、LLM自身をツリー検証器として並列検証するツリーベース投機的推論で生成LLMサービングのレイテンシと計算量を分布を保ちながら削減するシステムであり、投機的デコードによるサービング高速化に直接貢献する。

candidates.title: StreamDCIM: A Tile-based Streaming Digital CIM Accelerator with Mixed-stationary Cross-forwarding Dataflow for Multimodal Transformer
candidates.venue: International Symposium on Circuits and Systems
candidates.abstract: Multimodal Transformers are emerging artificial intelligence (AI) models designed to process a mixture of signals from diverse modalities. Digital computing-in-memory (CIM) architectures are considered promising for achieving high efficiency while maintaining high accuracy. However, current digital CIM-based accelerators exhibit inflexibility in microarchitecture, dataflow, and pipeline to effectively accelerate multimodal Transformer. In this paper, we propose StreamDCIM, a tile-based streaming digital CIM accelerator for multimodal Transformers. It overcomes the above challenges with three features: First, we present a tile-based reconfigurable CIM macro microarchitecture with normal and hybrid reconfigurable modes to improve intra-macro CIM utilization. Second, we implement a mixed-stationary cross-forwarding dataflow with tile-based execution decoupling to exploit tile-level computation parallelism. Third, we introduce a ping-pong-like fine-grained compute-rewriting pipeline to overlap high-latency on-chip CIM rewriting. Experimental results show that StreamDCIM outperforms non-streaming and layer-based streaming CIM-based solutions by geomean 2.63×and 1.28× on typical multimodal Transformer models.
candidates.reason: StreamDCIMはマルチモーダルTransformer向けに通常／ハイブリッド再構成モードを持つタイル型ストリーミングデジタルCIMマクロとクロスフォワーディングデータフローを備えた推論アクセラレータで、Transformer推論のハードウェア高速化に直接貢献する。

candidates.title: Understanding and Optimizing Multi-Stage AI Inference Pipelines
candidates.reason: 多段階AI推論パイプラインの理解と最適化として、RAG・KVキャッシュ取得・動的ルーティング・多段推論を含む異種LLMサービングを、実ハードウェアトレースと解析モデルで模擬する多段階推論実行シミュレータ（HERMES／MIST）を提案し、バッチングや遠隔KV取得のトレードオフを事例評価しており、推論基盤のシミュレーションに直接貢献する。
